{{Quote|This one is their leader. I have need of him.|Commander Tsalok, refering to the captain.|<ref name="IR3" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''[[Captain/Legends|captain]]''' led a recon force that was tasked with gathering information on the [[Shaper research facility]] on [[Dibrook]] by [[Kaye Galfridian]]. His group was ambushed by [[Tsalok]] and other [[Yuuzhan Vong]] warriors. He was ripped in half by Tsalok as an example of the Yuuzhan Vong's cruelty and strength.<ref name="IR3" />
